insights.one_liner: HighRadius is a US-based finance-automation software company of about 4,650 people with an Amsterdam office that is an IND recognised sponsor.

culture.text: A software company of around 4,649 people, headquartered in Houston, building AI tools that automate finance teams' work like invoicing, payments and treasury.
Staff mostly studied computer science and engineering, many at Indian universities such as KIIT, Chandigarh University and SRM.
Main functions are engineering, IT, consulting and business development.

open.text: HighRadius B.V. is an IND recognised visa sponsor.

growth.text: Founded in 2006, it says it serves 1,300+ enterprises including 3M, Unilever, Red Bull and Lufthansa.
